history.summary: PROBABLE DUPLICATE of seq 803 / Shirdi Sai Baba Temple (id shirdi-sai-baba-temple-chandigarh): this CSV row carries the same name and city with no sector detail, so it almost certainly refers to the same Shirdi Sai Samaj shrine rather than a distinct temple (Chandigarh has smaller Sai mandirs in other sectors, but none prominent enough to be the CSV row - verify). The Shirdi Sai Baba Temple at Sector 29A, Chandigarh (Plot No. 6, Sai Baba Road, Ordnance Cable Factory Colony) is managed by the Shirdi Sai Samaj. The land was allotted in 1989, and the founder member, the late Shri I.P. Mehta, with colleagues, acquired it. The marble idol was originally brought from Jaipur, taken to Shirdi for due worship (pooja), and then installed in Chandigarh; the Swaroop Sthapna ceremony was held on 6 December 1995. The temple draws large crowds on Thursdays, especially for the evening aarti, and serves bhandara/langar. CSV state 'Haryana' is incorrect - Chandigarh is a Union Territory.
